documents.title: Noting In The Board Meeting Dated 29.10.2026 Delay In Submission Of Shareholding Pattern Under Reg 31(1)(B) To NSE.

analysis.summary: Menon Bearings Limited reported a 58.60% year-on-year growth in consolidated total income for Q2 FY27 and a 47% growth for H1 FY27 reaching INR 194.9 crores. Management expects annual revenue growth to exceed 30% in both FY27 and FY28, supported by strong demand from domestic OEMs and expanding exports to the USA. The company plans to invest approximately INR 5 crores in Menon Alkop and INR 4 crores in the Bearings segment over the next 12 to 15 months towards automation and quality inspection. Management targets EBITDA margins of about 23% for next year while continuing to fund capital expenditures through internal accruals. Menon Bearings Limited presented its Q2 & H1FY27 investor presentation, reporting consolidated revenue from operations of Rs.

guidance.claim: Management expects revenue growth to exceed 30% in FY27 and FY28 driven by domestic demand and USA exports.
guidance.quote: There will be more than 30% growth for this year, FY27, and similarly in '27-'28 also we expect, if all the things are in place, it will be more than 30% again, with the growth drivers are basically domestic and whatever export that USA exports are growing rapidly.

guidance.claim: The company expects an additional consolidated business of around INR 30 crores in FY27 based on its pipeline and discussions.
guidance.quote: And what I feel, that considering the current business pipeline and the commercial discussions and RFQs that we have received, for '26-'27, additional business expected is around INR 30 crores on consolidated basis.

guidance.claim: Management is targeting EBITDA margins of about 23% for next year.
guidance.quote: And what we are targeting for next year, the EBITDA margins will be about 23%.

guidance.claim: Management stated that INR 360 crores is a conservative revenue target for the year.
guidance.quote: So, INR360 crores, I would say is a conservative figure and we will stick to that.

guidance.claim: The company targets a conservative year-on-year growth rate of over 20%.
guidance.quote: You see, there is always a target, we have set ourselves on a conservative basis of 20% plus year on year.

guidance.claim: Menon Bearings targets Alkop division revenue of INR 100 crores for this year and around INR 125 crores for next year.
guidance.quote: For this year, we are targeting Alkop for INR100 crores, next year around INR125 crores.

guidance.claim: The company expects export contribution to rise to 37% of total revenue by next year.
guidance.quote: As we expect that by next year, the export may go up to 37% after total revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: OEM business grew by nearly 50% and exports grew by over 75% compared to the same quarter last year.
demand_outlook.quote: We can see there is a growth as compared to the same quarter last year. There is a growth in OEM's business by almost 50%, and similarly there is a growth in export more than 75%.

demand_outlook.claim: EV growth rate has increased to 20% within the Alkop segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Our growth rate is almost 14% to 15%, whereas in EV it has gone up to 20%, and we are more and more getting into the EV business so far as Alkop is concerned.

demand_outlook.claim: Underlying demand in the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging despite global uncertainties.
demand_outlook.quote: While the global business environment continues to present certain uncertainties, the underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: Tractor segment demand is slightly impacted by monsoon conditions in drought-like parts but is expected to recover.
demand_outlook.quote: You see, considering the monsoon position that may -- in tractor segment affect today to some extent, not larger, because in some parts there is a drought-like situation, but it is expected to improve within this month or next month.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans an investment of around INR 5 crores in Alkop and INR 4 crores in bearings over the next 12 to 15 months.
capex_expansion.quote: So INR 5 crores in Alkop and around INR4 crores in bearing.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is implementing rooftop solar to achieve electricity savings.
capex_expansion.quote: Saving in electricity by rooftop solar, that is another.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has planned an additional ₹2.50 crore capex for the Brakes division over the next two years.
capex_expansion.quote: ₹0.58 crore fully deployed in FY26 with ₹2.50 crore additional planned over next 2 years

capex_expansion.claim: Five robotic automation projects are scheduled for rollout between November 2026 and April 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: Five initiatives rolling out Nov 2026 – Apr 2027 to lift productivity, quality and machine utilization

capex_expansion.claim: The company is spending INR 9 crores to INR 10 crores in FY27 to expand bi-metal capacity by 25% to 30%.
capex_expansion.quote: If you go through the presentation, Rucheeta, you will come to know that we are investing about INR9 crores to INR10 crores of rupees for this year, this financial year for increasing the capacity and which is expected to increase the capacity by almost 25% to 30%, which may yield the total revenue of more than INR25 crores, which can generate revenue of INR25 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: CapEx for the Alkop division is planned at around INR 4 crores for the current year.
capex_expansion.quote: And we are having the CapEx of around INR4 crores of for this year in Alkop alone.

capex_expansion.claim: The brake segment dynamometer installation is expected to be completed by the end of August.
capex_expansion.quote: You see, basically that is under construction now and is expected by the end of August.

capex_expansion.claim: Future CapEx is expected to generate an asset turnover of around 2.5 times.
capex_expansion.quote: See, whatever future CapEx that we are going to do, the additional CapEx will have asset turn of around 2.5.

margins_costs.claim: Input prices for key raw materials increased significantly, with tin up 72%, copper up 50%, and steel up 12%.
margins_costs.quote: Just to put in numbers, tin has increased by 72%, copper by 50%, steel by 12%.

margins_costs.claim: Margins in the Brakes segment range between 30% and 35%.
margins_costs.quote: Okay, so far as Brakes is concerned, the margins are 30% to 35%.

margins_costs.claim: Segment margins stand at 18% to 19% in Alkop and 23% in Bearings.
margins_costs.quote: In Alkop, it is 18% to 19%, whereas in Bearing, it is 23%, okay?

margins_costs.claim: Q2FY27 EBITDA margin reached 22.00%, up from 17.12% in Q2FY26.
Strategic sustainability investments are focused on driving operational efficiency and cost savings.
margins_costs.quote: These strategic initiatives demonstrate a commitment to sustainability, operational efficiency, and cost savings.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for Q1 FY27 reached over 21% for bi-metal, almost 21% for Alkop, and 25% for brakes.
margins_costs.quote: So, for the bi-metal is concerned the margin, so, EBITDA margins are around 21% plus. Then Alkop, it is almost 21%. And now, for this quarter, in brakes, we have achieved 25%.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margins are expected to be sustained around 20% to 21% over time.
margins_costs.quote: But overall, on a consolidated basis, if you see, we will sustainaround 20% to 21% of margins over a period of time.

margins_costs.claim: Carbide tool consumable prices have increased by 300%.
margins_costs.quote: Consumables, for example, carbide tools for all manufacturers, all automobile carbide tools are required.Those carbide tools price are increased by 300%.

margins_costs.claim: Average raw aluminium prices have increased to INR 340-370.
margins_costs.quote: But now average aluminium rates have become INR340, INR370.

orders_capacity.claim: Recent Europe tours yield potential business of over INR 35 crores to be converted into sales in FY28 and FY29.
orders_capacity.quote: Along with that, our recently Europe tour is yielding a significant increase in the business and potential of more than INR 35 crores that will be converted into the actual sale in the year '27-'28 and '28-'29.

orders_capacity.claim: Management expects additional business of INR 157 crores for 2029 excluding European potential business.
orders_capacity.quote: And with this, for 2029, we expect additional business of INR 157 crores, excluding potential business of INR 35 crores of Europe that we estimate it will take little more time, but 100% we are going to convert that.

orders_capacity.claim: Potential additional business for FY27 and FY28 is estimated at INR 65 crores to INR 75 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: The total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year is expected to be around INR65 crores to INR75 crores, subject to good monsoon and geopolitical situation doesn't worsen further.

capital_allocation.claim: The company finances its capital expenditures entirely out of internal accruals without taking term loans.
capital_allocation.quote: Whatever CapEx that we are doing, that is out of internal accruals, which are definitely having the impact on the cash accruals.

capital_allocation.claim: Cash and bank balances including mutual funds stood at INR 25.69 crores as of H1 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: PAT by 89.55%, and cash and bank balance including mutual funds INR 25.69 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Planned CapEx for bi-metal and Alkop divisions will be funded entirely through internal accruals without fresh debt.
capital_allocation.quote: You see, so far as whatever we are considering so far as bi-metal and Alkop is concerned, it will be through internal accruals only, no fresh loan will be taken.

risks_headwinds.claim: Export sales and distribution costs increased substantially due to higher shipping freight rates to the USA and Europe.
risks_headwinds.quote: So far sales and distribution expenses are concerned in exports; the freight so far as shipment of exports to USA and maybe other European countries as well.

risks_headwinds.claim: Merchant export orders were delayed for three months due to war backlog and Strait of Hormuz issues.
risks_headwinds.quote: But last three months, those merchant export orders were stuck because of backlog because of the Straight of Hormuz and the war.

risks_headwinds.claim: Shipping cargo and transport costs have increased significantly.
risks_headwinds.quote: Basic ship cargo transportation has increased significantly.

management_commitments.claim: Management commits to achieving more than 30% revenue growth in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: There will be more than 30% growth for this year, FY27, and similarly in '27-'28 also we expect, if all the things are in place, it will be more than 30% again, with the growth drivers are basically domestic and whatever export that USA exports are growing rapidly.

management_commitments.quote: And we are having the CapEx of around INR4 crores of for this year in Alkop alone.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
